divine-dry-oil.nom: Kallow Divine Touch Multi-Purpose Dry Oil
divine-dry-oil.accroche: A dry oil for face, body and hair with sunflower, argan and olive oils.
divine-dry-oil.description:
Divine Touch dry oil is applied to the face, body and hair. Its base of plant oils — sunflower, argan, olive — and vitamin E absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy film, hence the name “dry” oil.

100 ml bottle, fragranced. It pairs with the shower gel and the lotion from the Luxury Aromatic series.
divine-dry-oil.composition: Coco-Caprylate/Caprate, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil, Parfum, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Olea Europaea Fruit Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, BHT, fragrance components (Linalool, Limonene, Citronellol, Geraniol, Coumarin, Benzyl Salicylate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Hydroxycitronellal, Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone).
divine-dry-oil.usage:
Apply a few drops to the skin or the lengths of the hair and massage in lightly.
Do not rinse.
divine-dry-oil.points:
Sunflower, argan and olive oils
Face, body and hair
Absorbs quickly, no greasy film

divine-night-oil.nom: Kallow Divine Touch Nourishing Night Oil
divine-night-oil.accroche: A night face oil with grapeseed, apricot, avocado and argan oils.
divine-night-oil.description:
Nourishing Night Oil is applied in the evening, as the last step, to clean skin. It combines six plant oils — grapeseed, apricot kernel, avocado, argan, olive, sacha inchi — with vitamins A, C and E.

30 ml bottle. A few drops are enough; avoid the eye area and do not rinse.
divine-night-oil.composition: Vitis Vinifera Seed Oil, Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil, Persea Gratissima Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Tocopheryl Acetate, Olea Europaea Fruit Oil, Retinyl Palmitate, Plukenetia Volubilis Seed Oil, Carthamus Tinctorius Seed Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Ascorbyl Palmitate, BHT, Linoleic Acid.
divine-night-oil.usage:
In the evening, after cleansing and the rest of your skincare routine, apply a few drops to the face and neck.
Avoid the eye area. Do not rinse.
divine-night-oil.points:
Six plant oils
Vitamins A, C and E
A few drops in the evening, no rinsing

divine-face-cream.nom: Kallow Divine Touch Lifting Impact Face Cream
divine-face-cream.accroche: A rich face cream with peptides, green apple cells and avocado, apricot and argan oils.
divine-face-cream.description:
Lifting Impact Face Cream is the face cream in the Divine Touch line. Its rich texture brings together a peptide complex, a green apple (Malus domestica) cell extract, sodium hyaluronate and avocado, apricot and argan oils, with vitamins A, C and E.

50 ml jar. It is designed to be applied after the Divine Touch serum, but can also be used on its own.
divine-face-cream.composition: Aqua, Persea Gratissima Oil, Prunus Armeniaca Kernel Oil, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Olea Europaea Fruit Oil, Retinyl Palmitate, Malus Domestica Fruit Cell Culture Extract, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Tocopheryl Acetate, Trifluoroacetyl Tripeptide-2, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Sodium Hyaluronate Crosspolymer, Fomes Officinalis Extract… Full INCI list on the packaging.
divine-face-cream.usage:
Apply to clean face and neck, morning and/or evening.
After the Divine Touch serum if you use it.
divine-face-cream.points:
Peptides and green apple cells
Avocado, apricot and argan oils
50 ml jar, rich texture

kallow-foaming-cleanser.nom: Kallow Aloe & Chamomile Instant Foaming Cleanser
kallow-foaming-cleanser.accroche: A foaming face cleanser with aloe vera and chamomile, 92% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-foaming-cleanser.description:
This face cleanser comes out as a light foam as soon as you press the pump. Its formula combines aloe vera and chamomile; it is used on a damp face and neck, morning or evening, then rinsed off with water. All skin types, according to the manufacturer.

150 ml pump bottle, reference SC081 in the Kallow range, DXN's cosmetics line made in Greece. Label: 92% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-foaming-cleanser.composition: Contains, among other things, aloe vera (Aloe barbadensis) and chamomile (Chamomilla recutita). 92% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-foaming-cleanser.usage:
Massage a small amount of foam into a damp face and neck, morning or evening.
Rinse with clean water.
kallow-foaming-cleanser.points:
Aloe vera and chamomile
92% ingredients of natural origin (label)
150 ml pump bottle, rinses off with water

kallow-tightening-serum.accroche: A face serum with a tightening effect, containing active pearls and disaccharides of natural origin.
kallow-tightening-serum.description:
Instant Tightening Serum is a face serum with a tightening effect. Its formula contains active pearls with a pearlescent finish and disaccharides of natural origin. It is applied to clean skin, before your day cream; the manufacturer presents it as a make-up base.

30 ml pump bottle, reference SC082. Label: 95% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-tightening-serum.composition: Contains, among other things, active pearls and disaccharides of natural origin. 95% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-tightening-serum.usage:
Apply a few drops to clean face and neck.
Leave to absorb, then apply your day cream or make-up.
kallow-tightening-serum.points:
Tightening effect, serum texture
95% ingredients of natural origin (label)
30 ml bottle, before your day cream

kallow-micellar-tonic.nom: Kallow Sage & Witch Hazel Micellar Cleansing Tonic Water
kallow-micellar-tonic.accroche: A micellar toning water with sage and witch hazel, no rinsing needed.
kallow-micellar-tonic.description:
This micellar toning water with sage and witch hazel is used on a cotton pad, morning and evening, on the face and neck. It removes make-up, including around the eyes, and is not rinsed off.

200 ml bottle, reference SC084. Label: 99% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-micellar-tonic.composition: Contains, among other things, sage extract (Salvia officinalis) and witch hazel extract (Hamamelis virginiana). 99% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-micellar-tonic.usage:
Soak a cotton pad and sweep it over the face and neck, morning and evening.
Do not rinse.
kallow-micellar-tonic.points:
Sage and witch hazel
99% ingredients of natural origin (label)
On a cotton pad, no rinsing, 200 ml

kallow-face-mask.nom: Kallow Spirulina & Avocado Hydrating Face Mask
kallow-face-mask.accroche: A hydrating night mask with spirulina, avocado and macadamia oil.
kallow-face-mask.description:
This hydrating face mask is applied in the evening, as the last step of your skincare routine, and left on overnight: no rinsing. Its formula combines spirulina, avocado oil and macadamia oil.

75 ml jar, reference SC085. Also available as a pack of 10 × 5 ml samples. Label: 96% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-face-mask.composition: Contains, among other things, spirulina, avocado oil (Persea gratissima) and macadamia oil. 96% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-face-mask.usage:
In the evening, apply a small amount to clean face, avoiding the eye area.
Leave on overnight, without rinsing.
kallow-face-mask.points:
Spirulina, avocado, macadamia
Night mask, no rinsing
75 ml jar

divine-face-serum.nom: Kallow Divine Touch Lifting Impact Face Serum
divine-face-serum.accroche: The face serum in the Divine Touch line, with peptides, hyaluronic acid and apple cells.
divine-face-serum.description:
Lifting Impact Face Serum is the serum in Kallow's Divine Touch line, for the face, neck and décolleté. Its formula brings together a peptide complex, an apple cell extract, hyaluronic acid, vitamins E, C and F, retinol (vitamin A) and biosaccharides of natural origin. It is applied after cleansing, before your day or night cream; it is designed to go on before the Lifting Impact Face Cream.

30 ml pump bottle, reference SC088. Also available in single-use sachets of 10 × 2 ml. Label: 97% ingredients of natural origin.
divine-face-serum.composition: Contains, among other things, a peptide complex, an apple cell extract (Malus domestica), hyaluronic acid, vitamins E, C and F, retinol and biosaccharides. 97% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
divine-face-serum.usage:
After cleansing, apply a few drops to the face, neck and décolleté.
Leave to absorb before your day or night cream.
divine-face-serum.points:
Peptides, apple cells, hyaluronic acid
97% ingredients of natural origin (label)
30 ml bottle, before the Lifting Impact Face Cream

kallow-body-lotion.accroche: A body lotion with hyaluronic acid, aloe vera and olive oil, with the same fragrance as the Luxury Aromatic shower gel.
kallow-body-lotion.description:
Luxury Aromatic Body Lotion is the body lotion in Kallow's Luxury Aromatic series. Its formula combines hyaluronic acid, aloe vera and olive oil, with the series' floral fragrance. It is applied in small amounts after showering and pairs with the shower gel and the dry oil from the same series.

250 ml pump bottle, reference SC093. Also available in single-use sachets of 10 × 5 ml. Label: 95% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-body-lotion.composition: Contains, among other things, hyaluronic acid, aloe vera (Aloe barbadensis) and olive oil (Olea europaea). 95% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-body-lotion.usage:
Apply a small amount to the body after showering, on dry skin.
Massage in until absorbed.
kallow-body-lotion.points:
Hyaluronic acid, aloe vera, olive oil
Same fragrance as the Luxury Aromatic shower gel
250 ml pump bottle

kallow-lip-balm.accroche: A lip balm with cocoa butter and shea butter, in a 7 ml jar.
kallow-lip-balm.description:
Moisturizing Lip Balm is Kallow's lip balm. Its formula is based on cocoa butter and shea butter. A small 7 ml jar to keep in a bag or pocket; it is applied with a fingertip to clean, dry lips, as often as needed.

Reference SC094. Label: 99% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-lip-balm.composition: Contains, among other things, cocoa butter (Theobroma cacao) and shea butter (Butyrospermum parkii). 99% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-lip-balm.usage: Apply to clean, dry lips as often as needed.
kallow-lip-balm.points:
Cocoa butter and shea butter
99% ingredients of natural origin (label)
7 ml jar, pocket size

kallow-hand-cream.accroche: A hand cream with shea butter and a non-greasy texture, in a 75 ml jar.
kallow-hand-cream.description:
Nourishing Hand Cream is Kallow's hand cream, made with shea butter. The manufacturer presents it as non-greasy and lightly fragranced, intended for dry or chapped hands. It is applied to clean, dry hands as often as needed.

75 ml jar, reference SC095. Label: 96% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-hand-cream.composition: Contains, among other things, shea butter (Butyrospermum parkii). 96% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-hand-cream.usage:
Apply a small amount to clean, dry hands and massage in.
Reapply after each wash if needed.
kallow-hand-cream.points:
Shea butter, non-greasy texture
96% ingredients of natural origin (label)
75 ml jar

kallow-sunscreen-spf30.accroche: An SPF 30 body sunscreen emulsion with hyaluronic acid, glycerin and vitamin E.
kallow-sunscreen-spf30.description:
Essential Sunscreen Emulsion SPF 30 is Kallow's sun protection for the body: a fluid emulsion with a protection factor of 30, containing hyaluronic acid, glycerin and vitamin E. It is applied before sun exposure and reapplied often, especially after sweating, swimming or towelling off.

150 ml pump bottle, reference SC096. For the face, the line offers an SPF 50+. Label: 89% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-sunscreen-spf30.composition: Contains, among other things, hyaluronic acid, glycerin and vitamin E. 89% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-sunscreen-spf30.usage:
Apply generously to the body before sun exposure.
Reapply often, especially after sweating, swimming or towelling off.
kallow-sunscreen-spf30.points:
SPF 30, for the body
Hyaluronic acid, glycerin, vitamin E
150 ml pump bottle

kallow-tanning-oil.accroche: A body oil for sun exposure, with coconut, sunflower and carrot oils.
kallow-tanning-oil.description:
Natural Tanning Oil is a body oil with coconut, sunflower and carrot oils, plus vitamin E. It is applied all over the body, after Kallow sun protection or on its own.

150 ml bottle, reference SC097. It has no sun protection factor: combine it with an SPF product according to how long you are in the sun. Label: 95% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-tanning-oil.composition: Contains, among other things, coconut oil (Cocos nucifera), sunflower oil (Helianthus annuus), carrot oil (Daucus carota) and vitamin E. 95% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-tanning-oil.usage:
Apply all over the body, after sun protection or on its own.
Does not replace a product with an SPF.
kallow-tanning-oil.points:
Coconut, sunflower and carrot oils
No SPF: use with sun protection
150 ml bottle

kallow-after-sun.accroche: An after-sun gel with a cooling effect, made with aloe vera, yoghurt, mint and cucumber.
kallow-after-sun.description:
Cooling After Sun is Kallow's after-sun gel: a cool texture with aloe vera, yoghurt, mint and cucumber extracts, plus vitamin E and a summery fragrance. It is applied all over the body after sun exposure; the manufacturer recommends keeping it in the fridge for extra freshness.

150 ml bottle, reference SC098. It complements the SPF 30 emulsion and the oil from the same series. Label: 94% ingredients of natural origin.
kallow-after-sun.composition: Contains, among other things, aloe vera (Aloe barbadensis), yoghurt, mint and cucumber extracts, and vitamin E. 94% ingredients of natural origin according to the label. Full INCI list on the packaging.
kallow-after-sun.usage:
Apply enough to cover the whole body after sun exposure.
Can be kept in the fridge.
kallow-after-sun.points:
Aloe vera, yoghurt, mint, cucumber
Cool gel, to keep in the fridge if you like
150 ml bottle

divine-men-after-shave.nom: Kallow Divine Men Calming After Shave
divine-men-after-shave.accroche: A soothing after-shave lotion in a 100 ml bottle.
divine-men-after-shave.description:
Divine Men Calming After Shave is the after-shave lotion in Kallow's men's line. It is applied to the face straight after shaving.

100 ml bottle.
divine-men-after-shave.composition: Full INCI list on the packaging.
divine-men-after-shave.usage: Apply to the face after shaving, on clean, dry skin.
divine-men-after-shave.points:
Soothing after-shave
Divine Men, the men's line
100 ml bottle

summer-bling-mist.nom: Kallow Summer Bling Hair & Body Mist
summer-bling-mist.accroche: A light fragranced mist for hair and body, in a 100 ml bottle.
summer-bling-mist.description:
Summer Bling Hair & Body Mist is a fragranced mist to spray on the hair and body, lighter than a perfume. Also available in a Pink Glow version.

100 ml bottle.
summer-bling-mist.composition: Full INCI list on the packaging.
summer-bling-mist.usage:

Reapply throughout the day.

Lighter than a perfume

100 ml bottle.

kallow-sunscreen-spf50-echantillons.accroche: The SPF 50+ face sunscreen in 10 doses of 2 ml, to try it out.

ganozhi-soap.accroche: A body and face soap with Ganoderma extract and palm oil, with no artificial colouring.
ganozhi-soap.description:
Ganozhi Soap is an 80 g bar made with palm oil and enriched with Ganoderma lucidum extract, which gives it its natural brown colour. It is suitable for all skin types and can also be used for shaving.

No artificial colouring. Let the soap dry between uses to make it last.
ganozhi-soap.composition: Palm oil washing base, Ganoderma lucidum extract, glycerin, fragrance. Full INCI list on the packaging.
ganozhi-soap.usage: Work into a lather on wet skin, massage in and rinse.
ganozhi-soap.points:
Ganoderma extract and palm oil
No artificial colouring
Body, face and shaving

ganozhi-shampoo.accroche: A pH-balanced shampoo with Ganoderma extract and vitamin B5, for all hair types.
ganozhi-shampoo.description:
Ganozhi Shampoo washes the hair with a pH-balanced formula enriched with Ganoderma lucidum extract and panthenol, vitamin B5. It is suitable for all hair types and for frequent use.

250 ml bottle.
ganozhi-shampoo.composition: Aqua, Cocamide DEA, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Parfum, Ganoderma Lucidum Extract, Glycerin, Hydroxyethylcellulose, Lanolin, Panthenol, Sodium Laureth Sulfate… Full INCI list on the bottle.
ganozhi-shampoo.usage:
Apply to wet hair, lather, rinse.
Repeat if necessary.
ganozhi-shampoo.points:
Ganoderma extract and vitamin B5
pH-balanced
All hair types, frequent use

ganozhi-body-foam.accroche: A gentle body wash foam with Ganoderma extract and vitamin E.
ganozhi-body-foam.description:
Ganozhi Body Foam is a gentle shower gel, formulated to wash without stripping the skin's natural film, according to DXN. It contains Ganoderma lucidum extract and vitamin E.

250 ml bottle. Suitable for all skin types.
ganozhi-body-foam.composition: Contains, among other things: Ganoderma lucidum extract, vitamin E (Tocopheryl Acetate), glycerin, mild washing agents (betaine, Sodium Laureth Sulfate). Full INCI list on the bottle.
ganozhi-body-foam.usage:
Put a few drops into your hand or onto a shower puff, add a little water and work into a lather.
Rinse.
ganozhi-body-foam.points:
Ganoderma extract and vitamin E
Gentle formula, all skin types
250 ml bottle

gano-massage-oil.accroche: A massage oil with palm oil and Ganoderma extract, for body and hair.
gano-massage-oil.description:
Gano Massage Oil, “Minyak Gosok Gano” on its original label, is a massage oil made of palm oil and Ganoderma lucidum extract. It is used on the body and can also be applied to the hair.

75 ml bottle. For external use only; avoid contact with the eyes.
gano-massage-oil.usage:
Shake well before use.
Apply the desired amount and massage gently.
For external use. In case of contact with the eyes, rinse thoroughly.
gano-massage-oil.points:
Palm oil and Ganoderma extract
For body and hair
For external use, 75 ml bottle

toiletries-travel-kit.accroche: The three Ganozhi essentials in travel size: shampoo, body wash foam and toothpaste.
toiletries-travel-kit.description:
The Toiletries Travel Kit brings together the three Ganozhi toiletries in small sizes that meet hand-luggage rules: the shampoo (50 ml), the body wash foam (50 ml) and the toothpaste (40 g), all with Ganoderma extract.

Handy for a weekend away, or to try the range before the full sizes.
toiletries-travel-kit.format: Shampoo 50 ml, body foam 50 ml, toothpaste 40 g
toiletries-travel-kit.composition: Ganozhi Shampoo 50 ml, Ganozhi Body Foam 50 ml, Ganozhi Toothpaste 40 g. Full INCI lists on each pack.

Ganoderma extract
Sizes allowed in hand luggage

chubby-baby-oil.accroche: A gentle body oil for babies' skin, in a 200 ml bottle.

Chubby Baby Oil is a gentle body oil designed for the skin of babies and young children: after the bath, for massage or to moisturise dry areas.

200 ml bottle. For external use; avoid contact with the eyes.

For babies and young children

ganozhi-toothpaste.accroche: A toothpaste with Ganoderma extract, in a 150 g tube.

Ganozhi Toothpaste is the toothpaste in the Ganozhi range, formulated with Ganoderma lucidum extract and a mint flavour.

150 g tube. Also available as a set of 4 tubes of 40 g, handy for travelling.
ganozhi-toothpaste.composition: Contains, among other things, Ganoderma lucidum extract and mint flavouring. Full INCI list on the packaging.
ganozhi-toothpaste.usage:
Brush your teeth after every meal, at least twice a day.
Do not swallow.
ganozhi-toothpaste.points:
Ganoderma lucidum extract
Mint flavour
150 g tube

4 tubes of 40 g
Travel size

zhicare-toothpaste.nom: DXN Zhicare — tea tree and aloe vera toothpaste
zhicare-toothpaste.accroche: A toothpaste with tea tree oil and aloe vera.
zhicare-toothpaste.description:
Zhicare is DXN's second toothpaste: its formula combines tea tree oil (Melaleuca alternifolia) and aloe vera.

100 g tube.
zhicare-toothpaste.composition: Contains, among other things, tea tree oil (Melaleuca alternifolia) and aloe vera. Full INCI list on the packaging.
zhicare-toothpaste.usage:
Brush your teeth after every meal, at least twice a day.
Do not swallow.
zhicare-toothpaste.points:
Tea tree oil and aloe vera
DXN's second toothpaste
100 g tube
